line_items.reasoning: Q2 revenue of $678M exceeded the high end of prior guidance ($653M) by ~$25M or ~4%, with the company itself noting it beat the top of guidance by 5%.
U.S. commercial revenue grew 55% YoY (70% ex-strategic contracts), well above the guided 'at least 45% growth' threshold, with TCV booked surging 152% YoY and customer count up 83% YoY.

Q2 adjusted income from operations implied a 37% adjusted operating margin, and with record GAAP operating income of $105M and net income of $134M, results clearly exceeded the guided $209M–$213M adjusted income from operations range (actual adjusted operating income was ~$251M at 37% margin on $678M revenue).

GAAP operating income and net income were both achieved (seventh consecutive profitable quarter), consistent with guidance; adjusted free cash flow of $144M–$149M in Q2 keeps the full-year $800M–$1B target intact but implies significant back-half weighting, so no clear beat or miss yet.
